_comment: WS4 BROAD landscape sweep — granular, UNBIASED map of chi2/dof vs Pantheon+ across M, an explicit S sweep starting at 1 Gpc, and the centerM (outer-mass multiplier) axis. No prior config is privileged. Explicit S (not co-fit) so the full S-dependence is visible; runaway/anchor-failed cells (large M + small S, S_crit~M^(1/3)) are recorded with anchor_ok=False, not hidden. Selection by minimum chi2/dof vs Pantheon+; chi2_lcdm~0.436 / chi2_eds~0.843 are reference benchmarks only. Per the shell theorem the outer-mass shell exerts ~zero net force inside the observable region, so centerM is expected to be ~null for the isotropic chi2 (WS4 saw a(t) growth flat across centerM 1->3); this run tests that across the whole M/S map and out to centerM=10.
